title: Stranger Things star's rare disorder charity helps create 37 care guidelines
content: Cleidocranial dysplasia (CCD) affects bone and dental development in patients and requires specialized care. A recent study established 37 expert recommendations for diagnosing and managing this rare condition effectively. These guidelines emphasize the importance of coordinated care among various specialists and regular monitoring. Gaten Matarazzo, who has CCD, advocates for better recognition and treatment of the disorder. CCD Smiles organization aims to support patients through awareness and research initiatives.

title: Hyderabad student builds Rs 68,000 satellite receiver for remote villages

Plans are underway to introduce three units across ten villages in the Seraj Valley, significantly enhancing access to crucial weather data.

title: Elon Musk: Tesla to end Texas Cybertruck production to make way for Cybercab

Sales of the Cybertruck have been significantly below initial forecasts, prompting this decision. The Cybertruck faced multiple recalls and price adjustments since its launch in late 2023. Regulatory scrutiny is ongoing for the Cybercab, Tesla's centerpiece in its autonomous vehicle strategy. Despite the wind-down, Musk maintains that the Cybertruck was a remarkable technological achievement.

title: When Air Canada jet ran out of fuel at 41,000 feet in 1983: How all 69 survived
content: On July 23, 1983, an Air Canada Boeing 767 experienced a loss of engine power while traversing over Manitoba. With 61 passengers and 8 crew aboard, a serious fuel miscalculation by ground staff resulted in a 45 percent shortage. Remarkably, the pilots managed to glide the aircraft and executed an emergency landing on an old military track. Thankfully, everyone onboard suffered only minor injuries, and the plane was later restored.

title: Stephen Curry's wife Ayesha Curry praises Black Panther director Ryan Coogler

title: Patrick Mahomes’ $8 million Missouri estate: Inside his eight-acre luxury compound

The estate includes a private football field, a pool, and a gym designed for family use. Mahomes has a Texas home for the off-season, but Belton serves as the family's base during football season.

title: After dozens of flights, broadcasters across Europe get bomb threats - what's going on

title: Fears Starlink, builds one of its own: Russia rushes to scale up Rassvet

The country has launched 32 satellites this year to support military communications in Ukraine. The network currently struggles with limited coverage and intermittent service over specific areas. Russian officials have highlighted security risks posed by Western satellite services operating over sovereign territories.

title: Olympics once awarded medals for poetry; 1912 gold went to founder under 2 fake names
content: The Olympic Games once awarded gold medals for poetry, music, architecture, painting and sculpture alongside traditional sporting events. Introduced at Pierre de Coubertin’s insistence in 1912, the artistic competitions even saw the Olympic founder secretly win a literature gold medal under two assumed names. However, amateurism rules and declining interest eventually brought the unusual tradition to an end after the 1948 London Olympics.

title: London council rejects 1,060-home plan after affordable housing cut to 12%

title: NMC adds 9,783 PG medical seats, takes total to 68,305
content:
.

NEW DELHI: India's postgraduate medical education system is set for a major expansion, with 9,783 seats being added for the 2026-27 academic year. The increase takes the total approved PG intake to 68,305, up from 58,522, with govt medical colleges accounting for the largest share of the new seats. Of the additional seats, 4,373 have been added in govt colleges, 4,148 in private colleges and 1,262 in deemed universities, Dr M K Ramesh, president of NMC's Medical Assessment and Rating Board (MARB), told TOI. PG medical seats are spread across several states, with five accounting for a little over half of the national intake. Karnataka has the highest number, with 8,998 approved seats for 2026-27, followed by Maharashtra with 7,682. Uttar Pradesh has 6,983 seats, Tamil Nadu 6,819 and Telangana 4,417. Together, these five states account for 34,899 seats, or around 51% of the total.

End of Article

title: After hoaxes to flights, newsrooms in Bulgaria and Ireland get threats
content: a purported "Mikhail Andropov" claimed responsibility for a widening wave of hoax threats disrupting passenger flights across Europe . the messages were sent to Bulgaria's Nova TV and the Irish public broadcaster RTE, which evacuated its offices and suspended programming . Reuters was not able to establish the identity of the sender, the origin of the emails, or whether they had in fact come from the same source .

title: Manipur rebel arrested from Delhi hotel
content:
NEW DELHI: In an intelligence-backed operation, RK Regan Singh aka Gandhi, a wanted militant belonging to People's Liberation Army, Manipur, has been arrested from a hotel in south Delhi. PLA is a separatist militant group fighting for the creation of an independent and socialist Manipur. Confirming the arrest, special commissioner HGS Dhaliwal said that Gandhi's family members were the founders of the outfit. He was questioned about his presence in the capital before being handed over to Manipur Police. Acting on a tip-off, the crime branch set up technical surveillance and local intelligence gathering. The initial trail pointed toward the AIIMS area but it yielded nothing. Officers faced a major problem as they didn't have a photograph of militant. However, they managed to zero in on him in Yusuf Sarai.

End of Article

title: Meghan Markle's father arrested for possessing child sexual abuse materials
content: federal agents searched two storage units in the los Angeles area that Markle had reportedly rented since 2008 . they "seized approximately 78 items, including slides, film negatives, and books" the case came to light after Meghan's half-brother, Thomas Markle Jr, reportedly found a collection of such images while clearing out their father's former home in cebu City, Philippines .

title: Canada keeps a lid on immigration, locks in lower targets through 2029
content: immigration levels plan keeps intake of new temporary residents at 3.70 lakh annually . the overall annual target for permanent residents also remains unchanged at 3.80 lakh for each of the next three years . government has announced additional room to transition up to 2 lakh people already in Canada to permanent residence in 2027 .

title: Pak cracks down on protests in POK against rising cost of living, 20 feared dead

title: SIR: Deleted voters in 7 states/UTs can re-enrol without filling Form 6, EC says
content: EC: Electors across seven states/UTs undergoing SIR will be given one more opportunity to get their names included in the final electoral roll by filling up the SIR form afresh . they will no longer have to fill Form 6, meant for fresh enrolment, or Form 8, if excluded due to shifting of place of residence within the same state/UT .
